purpose: Shared Portfolio state/report architecture for AP Calculus AB. Exact Unit Assessment Plans own learning content. Unit 1 is evidence/report ready; later units fail closed until mapped.

mastered_default_rule.normal_requirement: At least two independent convincing demonstrations, normally from different opportunities, unless a rich artifact supplies genuinely independent evidence.
mastered_default_rule.accommodations: Approved accommodations do not lower the evidence status of a valid demonstration.

mastery_goal_rule.general_rule: A Mastery Goal is demonstrated when at least half of its exact I Cans, rounded up, are Mastered or Transfer.

mastery_goal_grade_model.not_assessed_rule: No usable evidence anywhere in the goal -> Not assessed. Family meaning: this Mastery Goal has not been checked yet. PowerSchool Score is blank.
mastery_goal_grade_model.general_scale_rule: Let n be exact I Can count and t=ceil(n/2). If assessed: I for secure<t; C for secure=t; B for t<secure<n; A for secure=n; A+ for secure=n plus meaningful transfer evidence in the goal.
mastery_goal_grade_model.unit_grade_rule: No overall Unit letter grade is reported or exported.

powerschool.output_rule: Produce one CSV per Mastery Goal per period; no Unit-grade CSV.

student_practice_link.missing_builder_rule: List focus I Cans on the student report but do not fabricate a QR/link.

priority_day_groups.ranking: I-grade count, then Practice + check soon gap count, then evidence severity
priority_day_groups.plan: Summarize the best common 20-minute Crewtime intervention for each selected group.

intervention_routing.pull_in_students: One landscape page; student-centered 1-2 Practice + check soon gaps.

student_support_contacts.rule: Store explicit relationships only; do not infer email addresses.
